event.title: Art Heist at Renoir Museum Leaves Two Paintings Missing
event.canonical_title: Art Heist at Renoir Museum Leaves Two Paintings Missing
event.summary: Thieves executed a heist at the Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer, French Riviera, stealing four paintings. During their escape, they abandoned two of the artworks in the museum's gardens as police pursued them. Local authorities are investigating the incident, noting that the thieves appeared well-prepared and knowledgeable about the museum's layout.

timeline.title: Two Renoir Paintings Stolen in French Riviera Heist
timeline.summary: Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer, France, on Tuesday, abandoning two others in the garden as they fled. This incident follows a series of art thefts in Europe, which experts suggest may be inspired by a high-profile heist at the Louvre last year.
key_facts: Two Renoir paintings stolen from a museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer, France.
Thieves abandoned two other paintings in the museum's garden.
The heist is part of a trend of recent art thefts in Europe.
